summary: The CorrespondenceGeneratedQueue class is part of the HSPnet system, responsible for managing and displaying a queue of generated correspondence reports. This system component includes functionalities for displaying reports, allowing email actions, and facilitating interactions with various controls such as drop-downs and buttons.
purpose: The primary purpose of the CorrespondenceGeneratedQueue is to manage and display a queue of correspondence reports within the HSPnet system, allowing users to perform actions such as marking reports as viewed or delivered, sending reports via email, and more.

workflows.name: Email Message Workflow
steps: Check if any checkbox from chkBoxList is checked.
Construct the email URL with SessionID.
Alert user if no checkbox is checked.

workflows.name: Refresh Data Workflow
steps: Refresh report lists and update the UI.

business_rules: Checkboxes must be checked for any action to proceed.
Recipient ID should not be '0' for emails.
validations: Ensure at least one checkbox is selected before performing an action.
Recipient IDs should not be '0' when sending emails.
conditions: If no checkbox from chkBoxList is checked, alerts are shown.
Actions depend on the value of ddAction.
system_behavior: Displays a list of reports in the queue.
Enables filtering and selection of reports.
Allows various actions like emailing and marking reports.
exceptions: No actions can be performed if all options are disabled or unchecked.
